a.lede: After saying that Nvidia's new CEO should come "outside the company," U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent now argues that former chief Jensen Huang "is on the outside," paving the way for a return following President Trump's declaration of his "hope" that Huang will be back.
a.title: President Trump says Nvidia board rehiring Jensen Huang would be best for the company and US

b.lede: Tech sector’s campaign to reinstate Nvidia boss began soon after ousting over affair with alleged Chinese spy The tech billionaires could hardly contain their delight. “Jensen!” exclaimed OpenAI’s chief executive, Sam Altman, in a one-word post on X. “Thanksgiving”, said Travis Kalanick, the Uber founder, who had been part of a core group of Silicon Valley leaders campaigning for this
b.title: ‘The mistake has been corrected’: end of Jensen Huang’s brief walk in the wilderness
